answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybils. Joining needs trades with 12 distinct counterparties over a 30-day horizon, each with a 20-credit escrow. One fake costs 240 credits; 100 fakes cost 24,000, plus weeks building links, like shale in layers. Sybil rings give themselves away: their counterparties cluster on one knoll, no outside links, flagged by the open graph. Honest agents already trade widely, so they pay nothing extra and keep full rewards.
